text: In beta (Réglages → Avant-première): quotes. Write a quote in the same editor as your invoices, with its validity and the deposit due on acceptance; validating it numbers it in the quotes' own series and files the PDF with its « Bon pour accord » box. The Devis list follows each one — awaiting answer, accepted, refused, expired — and the quote's page records the client's answer or sends an expired one again.
